g.title: crate Styles, lengths, colors, themes and the drawing vocabulary.
crate::asset Public image and font source values.
crate::color Colors: sRGB, theme tokens, theme-resolved values and colors in a
crate::color::css Parsing CSS color text (`Color::css`): names, hex and the functions
crate::color::value `Color` and its representation: sRGB, theme tokens and theme values.
crate::draw The `Draw` painter: shapes, paths, text, images, layers and canvas regions.
crate::draw::border_image `Draw::border_image`: a nine-slice picture or gradient drawn into a rect.
crate::draw::drawable `Draw::drawable`: a view subtree (a drawable) drawn into a canvas at a point.
crate::draw::filter The filter graph's value types, as SVG names them.
crate::draw::image Image values for the painter and the `Draw` commands that draw them.
crate::draw::layer Closure-scoped canvas groups and the `Draw::layer` command that records them.
crate::draw::local_paint A style's stored draw closure, equal by identity.
crate::draw::paragraph Shaped paragraphs: shaped once, queried for geometry, and drawn by `Draw`.
crate::draw::recorder The `Draw` recorder: its state, transform and the `Recording` it yields.
crate::draw::regions Canvas hit regions: their declaration and transformed geometry.
crate::draw::shapes Rectangle, line, path and shape commands of `Draw`.
crate::draw::text_run Text styles and runs of the painter, and the `Draw` text commands.
crate::effect Shapes, shadows, filters and blending, and their engine forms.
crate::effect::filter CSS filter functions (`Filter`) and their resolution to engine ops.
crate::effect::filter_graph The filter graph builder (SVG filter primitives written as values).
crate::effect::shadow `Shadow`: a box shadow with offset, blur, spread, color and inset.
crate::effect::shape Basic shapes (`Shape`) and the clip and draw forms the engine takes.
crate::facade Curated application style vocabulary forwarded by the public facade.
crate::geometry Geometry values: points, sizes, rectangles and corner radii.
crate::grid CSS Grid tracks and item placement.
crate::icon Name an icon by meaning or by its image, as plain data.
crate::internal Bridge style values and recording to core host machinery.
crate::length Layout units: pixels, percentages, fractions.
crate::paint Fills: colors, gradients and images, and the engine's fill layers.
crate::paint::background A box background: the stack of paint layers.
crate::paint::border_image CSS `border-image` (and the nine-slice of `Draw::border_image`): an
crate::paint::canvas_gradient Gradients placed by canvas coordinates: linear, two-circle radial and conic.
crate::paint::fill_layer Resolve paints, gradients and shader paints with the theme into wire fills.
crate::paint::gradient Gradients placed by the filled box: linear, radial and conic.
crate::paint::layer One paint layer: a color, gradient or image with its size, position and repeat.
crate::paint::mask CSS `mask` layers: paints whose alpha (or luminance) masks what is
crate::path Reusable canvas paths in the shared shape vocabulary.
crate::path::commands The `Path` value and the commands that build it: lines, curves, arcs and shapes.
crate::path::geometry Path geometry and coordinate operations.
crate::path::outline `Path::stroke_outline`: a line's outline as a path to fill.
crate::path::trim Path length measurement and trimming a path by length.
crate::resolve Style property resolution against the theme into node props.
crate::shader Shader paints and filter shaders: declarations and re-exports.
crate::shader::data A shader program and the values set on it: parameters, images, clock.
crate::shader::filter Filter shaders: `FilterShader`, and `ShaderFilter` with its builders.
crate::shader::paint_shader Paint shaders: `PaintShader`, and the builders of a `ShaderPaint`.
crate::shader::program Assembling a WGSL source into a shader program, and its errors.
crate::shader::value `ShaderValue`: the values a shader's `Params` struct takes.
crate::sheet `Style`: a flat value-type chain and every setter of its properties.
crate::text Text values: spacing, kerning, features, decoration, and their engine forms.
crate::theme Typed theme: token tables for color, spacing, radius, type and focus ring.
crate::theme::tokens Theme token tables: palette, spacing, radii and typography.
crate::theme::value The theme value, its extensions, and the colors resolved in it.
crate::transform Geometric transforms and layout transforms.
